title: Rep. Keith Self highlights law enforcement actions and national security concerns in recent posts - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a member of the U.S. House of Representatives from Texas, posted several statements on his social media account on January 21, 2026, addressing law enforcement actions and public opinion regarding national security.
In a post made at 21:23 UTC, Self reported an arrest in McKinney, Texas: ” ARRESTED: Illegal alien Oscar Hernandez Herrera, convicted of dangerous drugs and DUI, in McKinney, TX. @ICEgov is taking action to remove criminal offenders and protect our communities. Thank you for keeping Texans safe.” This message expressed support for ICE’s efforts to address criminal activity and highlighted concerns about community safety.
Later that evening at 22:03 UTC, Self referenced polling data regarding national sentiment toward radical Islam: “.@ScottWRasmussen polled that 77% of Americans are concerned about the influence of radical Islam in our nation. The numbers speak for themselves. DEFEND THE WEST. BAN SHARIA.” This post cited survey results and called for specific policy measures.
Shortly after, at 22:03 UTC, Self added another post encouraging further reading with a link: “READ MORE https://t.co/tqS1YXDoC6”.
Keith Self has been elected multiple times to represent his district in Texas. In the 2024 general election, he won against Sandeep Srivastava by securing approximately 62.5% of the vote compared to Srivastava’s 37.6%. Two years earlier in the 2022 election cycle, Self also defeated Srivastava with a similar margin of victory.
